title: TWITTER Gravel V3 public listing images
notes: The public mirror exposes whole-bike and component-detail images for the TWITTER Gravel V3 listing. Accepted images cover silver and alternate-color full-bike views, a white RS 24-speed alloy-wheel view, the integrated mechanical cockpit, and RS hydraulic calipers. Generic carbon-weave advertising and an icon-only specification graphic were rejected. The photographs do not establish a standard wheel material or selection. These assets support model or component-family image matching only: exact production year, drivetrain batch, price, and stock are not inferred from them.
